title: Remove read-only reviewer input manifests when their attempt ends
outcome: Per-attempt reviewer input manifests (termal-review-input-<delegation>-<attempt>.json in the reviewed worktree's own Git directory) are removed when the attempt is superseded, the delegation is torn down, or a launch or follow-up is rolled back after admission; stale pending follow-up admissions are dropped with them.
acceptance: A superseded, torn-down or rolled-back reviewer attempt leaves no termal-review-input manifest in the worktree's Git directory, and an active attempt's manifest is never removed; covered by regression tests.
A rejected follow-up leaves no pending review-input admission behind.
